source: Uchumi Supermarkets Plc audited consolidated statement of financial position as at 30 June 2025, as published in the FY2025 audited annual report (page 42 of the document, page numbering shown 42). Figures printed in KShs thousands and stored here as absolute KES: non-current assets 2,991,933 (2024: 3,002,862), current assets 88,848 (2024: 155,564), total assets 3,080,781 (2024: 3,158,426), non-current liabilities 10,105,970 (2024: 10,190,079), current liabilities 27,167 (2024: 30,672), total equity (7,052,356) (2024: (7,062,325)). | CRON 2026-11-18: the stored Current assets row held 10,579 (inventories only) and Non-current assets was the residual 3,070,202, so the split was wrong even though the totals tied. Both subtotals were replaced with the issuer printed figures: 2,991,933 + 88,848 = 3,080,781 as printed. Current Liabilities and Non-current Liabilities rows added from the same printed subtotals. Identity checks hold: assets 3,080,781 = liabilities 10,133,137 less equity 7,052,356.
